summary.text: Keith Greiner is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 43 who took office on December 1, 2012, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A certified public accountant, he chaired the House Finance Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Greiner earned a B.S. in accounting from Pennsylvania State University in 1987, and his professional experience includes working as a certified public accountant.
Greiner defeated Jennie Porter in the 2018 general election for District 43 and won re-election in 2020, 2022 and 2024.
Over his tenure his committee assignments have included Appropriations, Commerce, Finance and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness.
Democrat Bryan Peirson is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
